prompt: Review a proposed change that adds #import "FRNNativeCore-Swift.h" to packages/agentic/native-core/macos/components/Callout/paper/FRNCalloutManager.m so a new Paper property bridge can use the Swift CalloutView type.

assertions.description: Flags importing the generated Swift header into an RCT_EXTERN_MODULE registration file.
Recommends a Paper property bridge using React or AppKit base types or a Swift-implemented setter instead of generated Swift types.
Requires module and bridging-header validation, reporting any unrun Office check.
